channel.title: CVE Daily — AI Curated
channel.description: The day's 267 curated vulnerabilities pose a critical threat to enterprise security, driven primarily by Microsoft ecosystem flaws spanning desktop operating systems, cloud platforms, and network infrastructure. Unauthenticated remote code execution remains the dominant attack vector, frequently enabled by heap-based buffer overflows, use-after-free conditions, and insecure deserialization within core services including Windows DNS, DHCP, SMB, Exchange, Azure, and SQL Server. Notable risks include an actively exploited Windows Shell flaw added to CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, alongside significant exposures in industrial control systems and IoT devices that could grant attackers root access or disrupt operations. Immediate remediation is essential to mitigate widespread exploitation potential and protect against lateral movement, data exfiltration, and complete system compromise across diverse IT environments.
